intro: The unmarried partner visa is for couples who aren’t married but have lived together in a relationship like marriage for at least 2 years. Proving those 2 years is the key, and we help you build that evidence.
cardText: For couples who have lived together for at least 2 years.

rules.title: The 2-year rule
rules.text: You must have lived together for at least 2 years before you apply. Evidence should cover the whole period.

rules.title: The financial requirement
rules.text: Most new applications need £29,000 a year from income, savings or both. Some sponsors who receive certain benefits are exempt. [Read our financial requirement guide](/spouse-visa-financial-requirement/)

rules.title: English language
rules.text: A1 for a first application, A2 when you extend, and B1 for settlement, unless you are exempt. [Read our English language guide](/english-language-requirement/)

rules.title: Route to settlement
rules.text: Partners of British citizens keep a 5-year route to Indefinite Leave to Remain under the government’s plans. [Read about the ILR changes](/ilr-changes-2026/)

boxTitle: Want a second pair of eyes before you apply?
boxText: A consultation costs far less than a refused application. We’ll check your case against the current rules and tell you honestly where you stand.

sections.heading: Unmarried partner visa requirements
sections.text: You must both be 18 or over, have lived together in a relationship akin to marriage or civil partnership for at least 2 years, and intend to live together permanently in the UK. The financial, English language and accommodation requirements are the same as for a spouse visa.

sections.heading: Building your 2 years of evidence
sections.text: The Home Office usually wants to see documents addressed to you both, or each of you, at the same address, spread across the 2 years: tenancy agreements, council tax, utility bills and bank statements. We review what you have and tell you where the gaps are.

faqs.q: How long do we need to have lived together for an unmarried partner visa?
faqs.a: At least 2 years before you apply.

faqs.q: Do we need to have lived together in the UK?
faqs.a: No. The 2 years can be anywhere.

faqs.q: What if we got married recently?
faqs.a: You may apply as a spouse instead. We check which route is stronger.
